Title: [TC-2-BOUND-01] Session active at 29m59s of inactivity but expires at 30m00s
Description:
• Registered user exists with email: user@test.com and password: ValidPass1!
• Session inactivity timeout is configured to 30 minutes
• A stopwatch is available to time inactivity precisely
Test Data: email: user@test.com, password: ValidPass1!, timeout: 30m, checkpoints: 29m59s, 30m00s, 30m01s
Step Action: Log in as "user@test.com" with password "ValidPass1!" and start the stopwatch on reaching /dashboard
Step Expected Result: Dashboard is displayed and stopwatch shows 00:00

Step Action: Perform no interaction until the stopwatch reads 29m59s, then click the "Profile" link
Step Expected Result: Profile page loads and the session is still valid

Step Action: Reset the stopwatch and remain idle until it reads 30m00s, then click the "Dashboard" link
Step Expected Result: User is redirected to /login because the session has expired

Step Action: Log in again as "user@test.com" with password "ValidPass1!" and restart the stopwatch
Step Expected Result: Dashboard is displayed with a new session

Step Action: Remain idle until the stopwatch reads 30m01s, then click the "Profile" link
Step Expected Result: User is redirected to /login because the session has expired

Step Action: Observe the login page after the redirect
Step Expected Result: TEST PASS — session valid at 29m59s, expired at 30m00s and 30m01s, URL reads /login
